method: StatsProbe loads the unchanged StatList (pp) and reads every registered StatBase (pp.b, ph.e id, formatter ph.b) by reflection, the general/items/blocks lists (pp.c/d/e), the per-item arrays pp.C..F after block merging, the EntityList egg infos in HashMap order (sg.a) and formatter samples. screen, mining and triggers are literals read from the GuiStats and player class bytecode. lang is en_US.lang from the JAR.

screen.sort: click column c: if c!=o then o=c,p=-1; else if p==-1 then p=1; else o=-1,p=0. comparator: null stat last; differing values -> (va-vb)*p; else id difference

mining.mineBlock: Block.harvestBlock (aji.a and overrides): C[id]+1, only when the block was removed and canHarvestBlock

triggers.mountedOneCm: addMountedMovementStat: round(distance*100) by vehicle class (minecart, boat, pig, horse)
triggers.deaths: EntityPlayerMP.onDeath (also entityKilledBy of the last attacker)
triggers.killEntity: EntityPlayer.onKillEntity: the victim egg info kill stat
